name: σ-magma (sigma-magma)
rigidity_theorems: See J60 §6.2: |Aut| = 1, congruence-simple, 2-generated, unique sub-magma structure. These four rigidity conditions are sufficient to force the equational profile to equal the commutativity-forced minimum (Family C, size 14).
history: Discovered during Trinity Infinity Geometry exploration of permutation-quotient magmas. First documented in J59 (sigma-magma rigidity). σ chosen to break all linear and affine structure while preserving the bilinear shape x·y = f(x+y).
